en: AG35 (modem_mng, dual SIM)

en: EG25-specific ROAMLINK/CH channel fields

en: EC200A (modem_mng or upstream open_dial)

en: SIM_AT/SIM_CB heartbeat without SLOT

en: Application remained in start_call; subsequent monitoring state is unconfirmed;

en: Weak signal

en: Possible data stall (RX_PKT)

en: During SIM/operator switching or CFUN

en: Registration denied/limited or suspected account issue

zh: 数据服务未就绪
en: Data service not ready

en: Short SDK outage (link fluctuation, not established device failure)

zh: 未能归类
en: Unclassified

zh: artery 应用长期停留 start_call
en: artery application remained in start_call

zh: 【日志直证】连续心跳支持
en: [Log evidence] Consecutive heartbeats support

zh: 段 start_call 停留，最长
en: start_call dwell segments; longest

zh: 条心跳。观察规则为至少 300 秒、3 条心跳且相邻间隔不超过 120 秒，非协议超时。
en: heartbeats. Observation requires at least 300 seconds and 3 heartbeats with gaps no longer than 120 seconds; this is not a protocol timeout.

zh: 该段前记录了 SIM TCP 失败重拨。
en: SIM TCP failure and redial were recorded before this segment.

zh: 期间 SDK 仍报告联网；SDK 连通不代表应用恢复 net_connected。
en: SDK still reported connectivity; SDK connection does not establish application recovery to net_connected.

zh: 这是应用状态推进/后续监测异常证据，不能折算成整段业务断网。
en: This indicates abnormal application state progression/monitoring, not an outage spanning the entire period.

zh: 核对重拨后的 DataCall Stop/Start 与状态门控；日志未打印门控变量，具体代码原因需结合对应固件源码确认。补充 PID、业务探测和单调时间，勿以 tcp_fail=0 证明健康。
en: Review DataCall Stop/Start and state gates after redial. Gate variables are absent; verify the specific cause against firmware source. Collect PID, business probes and monotonic time. tcp_fail=0 does not establish health.

zh: artery 状态证据冲突，疑似混合实例/日志流
en: artery state conflict; possible mixed instances/log streams

zh: 【日志直证】明确状态迁移后，超过 15 秒仍重复出现相反的 start_call/net_connected 心跳（180 秒内至少两次）。【推断】可能有多个实例/日志流；无 PID，无法确定实例数量或逐行归属。
en: [Log evidence] After an explicit transition, opposite start_call/net_connected heartbeats continued beyond 15 seconds, at least twice within 180 seconds. [Inference] Multiple instances/log streams are possible; without PID, instance count and row ownership remain unknown.

zh: 按 PID/启动标识分别采集日志，并核对守护进程是否重复拉起；不要把这些心跳解释成同一实例反复迁移，也不要跨启动拼接停留时长。
en: Collect logs by PID/startup identifier and check for duplicate daemon starts. Do not interpret these heartbeats as repeated transitions of one instance or combine dwell time across starts.

zh: artery 旧版 SDK 断开回调
en: artery legacy SDK disconnect callbacks:

zh: 次
en: occurrences

zh: 【日志直证】Net disconnected 回调已纳入旧格式未归因计数；原始原因码不能证明是应用主动停止或 SDK 自发断开，回调区间也不等于业务中断区间。
en: [Log evidence] Net disconnected callbacks count as unattributed legacy events. Raw reason codes do not distinguish intentional application stops from spontaneous SDK disconnects; callback intervals do not establish business outage intervals.

zh: 结合对应 Net Connected、业务探测和 RX 判断恢复；未识别业务断网不意味着业务 100% 可用，概览和报告按证据不足展示。
en: Review Net Connected, business probes and RX. No recognized outage does not establish 100% availability; overview and reports show insufficient evidence.

zh: 恢复记录缺少可信故障起点或时长不可能，已排除出断网统计
en: Recovery lacks a credible fault start or has an impossible duration; excluded from outage statistics

zh: 恢复行必须与同一日志来源内的 fault timer started 配对；声明时长还必须
en: A recovery row must pair with fault timer started in the same log source. Its declared duration must also

zh: 不超过该来源的实际观测跨度。未满足时通常表示日志缺失、授时跳变或残留
en: not exceed the source's actual observation span. Failure usually indicates missing logs, a clock jump or residual

zh: 状态，不能据此计算断网和可用率。
en: state; such values cannot establish outage duration or availability.

zh: 补充同进程的 unsynced/前序日志并核对系统授时记录；产品持续时间应使用
en: Collect the preceding/unsynced logs of the same process and system time synchronization records. Product durations should use

zh: CLOCK_MONOTONIC。工具已保留原始恢复值作为异常证据。
en: CLOCK_MONOTONIC. Original recovery values are retained as anomalous evidence.

zh: SIM 卡未插入，v2 正在低频轮询
en: v2 SIM absent; low-frequency polling active

zh: 日志明确返回 CME SIM not inserted。v2 对该分支采用 5s→10s→15s 的慢轮询，
en: The log explicitly reports CME SIM not inserted. v2 uses slow polling at 5s→10s→15s for this branch,

zh: 不会因卡缺失耗尽普通 CPIN 重试并复位模组。
en: so absence does not exhaust ordinary CPIN retries or reset the module.

zh: 检查 SIM 卡槽、卡片方向和接触；插卡后确认出现 sim ok，再继续排查注网/APN。
en: Check the SIM slot, orientation and contacts. After insertion, confirm sim ok before investigating registration/APN.

zh: 网络长期未注册，v2 已触发模组复位
en: v2 prolonged lack of registration triggered module reset

zh: 日志出现 No registered so long 或注册阶段失败后的 Reset modem 固定动作，
en: No registered so long or Reset modem after registration failure is recorded,

zh: 说明不是一次尚在等待的 CEREG/CGREG 采样。
en: not merely a CEREG/CGREG sample still waiting for registration.

zh: 核对同一时段的 CEREG/CGREG stat、LAC/CI/AcT、SIM 状态和运营商覆盖；
en: Review CEREG/CGREG stat, LAC/CI/AcT, SIM state and coverage for the same period.

zh: 复位反复出现时优先查注册条件，而不是继续缩短复位周期。
en: If resets recur, investigate registration conditions before shortening reset intervals.

zh: 连续 ping 失败触发重初始化
en: Consecutive ping failures triggered reinitialization

zh: v2 的 keepalive 重试次数已经达到配置上限，源码随后将状态转入 MD_ERROR，
en: v2 keepalive retries reached the configured limit; source transitions to MD_ERROR

zh: 重新执行模组初始化；单条 ping failed(x/y) 不会触发本结论。
en: and reinitializes the module. A single ping failed(x/y) does not trigger this finding.

zh: 结合 WAN down/up 断网区间和 CSQ/CEREG 指标判断是覆盖、注册还是数据面故障；
en: Use WAN down/up windows and CSQ/CEREG to distinguish coverage, registration and data-plane faults.

zh: 若频繁重初始化，保留完整周期日志。
en: Retain full-cycle logs if reinitialization recurs.

zh: 进入 READY 时 WAN 仍离线
en: WAN offline on entry to READY

zh: READY 横幅明确记录 online=0。v2 会继续在 READY 周期内刷新注册、CSQ 和 WAN，
en: The READY banner explicitly reports online=0. v2 keeps refreshing registration, CSQ and WAN in READY.

zh: 该行证明当时尚未联网，但不等同于进程初始化失败。
en: This proves connectivity was absent then, but does not establish process initialization failure.

zh: 查看随后是否出现 WAN ping OK；若持续离线，再结合注册状态和 SIM/CSQ 证据处理。
en: Check for later WAN ping OK. If offline persists, investigate registration and SIM/CSQ evidence.

zh: READY 状态失败并复位
en: READY state failed and reset

zh: 日志出现 failed to in ready state，表明状态机从 MD_READY 进入错误处理并调用模组复位。
en: failed to in ready state shows a transition from MD_READY to error handling and module reset.

zh: 回看此前连续 ping、WAN online、CEREG/CGREG 与 CSQ；区分网络不可达和模组/AT 端口异常。
en: Review preceding ping failures, WAN online, CEREG/CGREG and CSQ. Distinguish network reachability from module/AT-port faults.

zh: IMX6ULL 拨号失败，已进入退避重试
en: IMX6ULL dial failure entered backoff retry

zh: 【源码直证】旧版以 FAILURE/RETRY 记录退避；1.25.1 以 RECOVERY 的 class、level、
en: [Source-code evidence] Older versions record backoff under FAILURE/RETRY; 1.25.1 records the same action under RECOVERY using class, level,

zh: action、attempt 和 wait_s 记录同一动作。它们是恢复进行中的证据，不是联网恢复。
en: action, attempt and wait_s. These indicate recovery in progress, not restored connectivity.

zh: 按证据中的 state、pdn、if 和 reason 分流排查；保留完整失败—恢复周期，确认重试是否反复耗尽。
en: Investigate by state, pdn, if and reason. Retain the full failure/recovery cycle and check whether retries repeatedly exhaust.

zh: IMX6ULL SIM 未就绪
en: IMX6ULL SIM not ready

zh: 【源码直证】AT+CPIN 检查未返回 READY，状态机转入 FAILURE_RETRY。
en: [Source-code evidence] AT+CPIN did not return READY; the state machine entered FAILURE_RETRY.

zh: 检查卡槽、卡接触、PIN 锁状态和 CPIN 原始响应；SIM 未就绪前继续拨号没有意义。
en: Check the slot, contacts, PIN lock and raw CPIN response. Dialing cannot proceed while the SIM is not ready.

zh: IMX6ULL 网络注册等待失败
en: IMX6ULL registration wait failed

zh: 【源码直证】CEREG 响应无法解析或在注册等待窗口内超时，状态机未进入正常数据拨号。
en: [Source-code evidence] CEREG was unparseable or registration wait timed out; normal data dialing was not reached.

zh: 核对 CEREG、CSQ、运营商选择和 AT 端口响应；区分无注册、响应损坏和覆盖问题。
en: Review CEREG, CSQ, operator selection and AT responses. Distinguish no registration from damaged responses and poor coverage.

zh: IMX6ULL PDP 数据连接失败
en: IMX6ULL PDP connection failed

zh: 【源码直证】CID1 请求被拒、PDP 等待耗尽或状态不可解析，数据面尚未就绪。
en: [Source-code evidence] CID1 was rejected, PDP wait exhausted or state unparseable; the data plane is not ready.

zh: 核对 APN/PDP 类型、QNETDEVCTL/QNETDEVSTATUS 原始响应和模组侧 PDP 上下文。
en: Check APN/PDP type, raw QNETDEVCTL/QNETDEVSTATUS responses and module PDP contexts.

zh: IMX6ULL DHCP/IPv4/路由配置失败
en: IMX6ULL DHCP/IPv4/route configuration failed

zh: 【源码直证】DHCP 客户端失败或网卡没有 IPv4/默认路由，问题位于 AP 侧网络配置或链路可达性。
en: [Source-code evidence] DHCP failed or the interface lacked IPv4/default route; investigate AP-side configuration and reachability.

zh: 检查接口是否存在、udhcpc 进程与租约、IP/网关/路由/DNS；再复核探测端点可达性。
en: Check interface existence, udhcpc, lease, IP/gateway/routes/DNS, then probe-endpoint reachability.

zh: IMX6ULL 模组拓扑或 AT 通道不可用
en: IMX6ULL module topology or AT channel unavailable

zh: 【源码直证】USB 模组拓扑发现超时/失败，或已选 AT 端口打开、读写响应失败。
en: [Source-code evidence] USB topology discovery failed/timed out, or the selected AT port failed to open/read/write/respond.

zh: 检查 USB 枚举、option 驱动绑定、AT 端口节点及供电；确认网卡与 AT 口来自同一模组。
en: Check USB enumeration, option driver binding, AT nodes and power. Confirm the interface and AT port belong to the same module.

zh: IMX6ULL AT 遥测命令超时
en: IMX6ULL AT telemetry command timed out

zh: 【日志直证】心跳的 at_timeout=1 表示本轮遥测 AT 命令没有获得终止响应。
en: [Log evidence] at_timeout=1 means this heartbeat's telemetry AT command received no terminating response.

zh: 该字段本身不等同 AT 端口完全不可用；新版会另以 at_probe 或 [AT] 基础探测确认。
en: This alone does not establish total AT-port failure; newer versions confirm with at_probe or an [AT] basic probe.

zh: 查看同一心跳的 at_probe 及后续 [AT] timeout event；probe=ok 时优先保留现场观察，
en: Review at_probe and subsequent [AT] timeout events. With probe=ok, retain evidence and observe;

zh: probe=fail 或连续失败达到阈值时检查 AT 口、USB 与模组供电。
en: with probe=fail or threshold-level consecutive failures, check AT, USB and module power.

zh: IMX6ULL AT 基础确认探测失败
en: IMX6ULL basic AT confirmation probe failed

zh: 【源码直证】遥测超时后，拨号循环用裸 AT 探测确认控制面；连续失败达到配置阈值才升级恢复。
en: [Source-code evidence] After telemetry timeout, the dial loop confirms the control plane with bare AT. Recovery escalates only at the configured consecutive-failure threshold.

zh: 核对 failed streak/limit、AT 口节点和 USB 枚举；不要仅凭单条遥测超时直接判定模组失联。
en: Review failed streak/limit, AT nodes and USB enumeration. One telemetry timeout does not establish module disconnection.

zh: IMX6ULL 已执行 PDP 软重建恢复
en: IMX6ULL PDP soft rebuild executed

zh: 【源码直证】RECOVERY level=L2_PDP 的 soft-rebuild 会重建数据呼叫；达到上限才升级 CFUN。
en: [Source-code evidence] RECOVERY level=L2_PDP soft-rebuild reconstructs the data call; CFUN escalation follows only after the limit is reached.

zh: 核对 PDP 上下文、APN 和 QNETDEV 状态；若反复出现，保留每次 attempt 与 reason。
en: Review PDP context, APN and QNETDEV state. Retain each attempt and reason if recurring.

zh: IMX6ULL 已执行 CFUN 射频恢复
en: IMX6ULL CFUN radio recovery executed

zh: 【源码直证】RECOVERY level=L3_CFUN action=cycle 执行 CFUN=0/1，并受冷却时间限制。
en: [Source-code evidence] RECOVERY level=L3_CFUN action=cycle runs CFUN=0/1, subject to cooldown.

zh: 结合注册状态与 cooldown 观察；频繁升级说明 PDP 软重建未解决根因。
en: Review registration and cooldown. Repeated escalation indicates PDP soft rebuild did not resolve the cause.

zh: IMX6ULL 已升级硬件级模组恢复
en: IMX6ULL recovery escalated to module hardware

zh: 【源码直证】RECOVERY level=L4_HARDWARE 进入后会执行 power-cycle，并持久化冷却时间。
en: [Source-code evidence] RECOVERY level=L4_HARDWARE executes power-cycle and persists cooldown time.

zh: 检查 USB/供电/模组硬件和此前 AT 失败；保留冷却期内的完整日志，避免把延迟动作误判为卡死。
en: Check USB, power, hardware and preceding AT failures. Retain logs through cooldown to distinguish delayed action from a stall.

zh: IMX6ULL 拨号配置错误，恢复已停止
en: IMX6ULL configuration error stopped recovery

zh: 【源码直证】CONFIGURATION 类故障进入 CONFIG_ERROR，而非继续重拨或复位模组。
en: [Source-code evidence] CONFIGURATION faults enter CONFIG_ERROR rather than continued redial/module reset.

zh: 修正 APN、PDP 类型等配置后重启服务；重拨、CFUN 和硬件复位不能修复配置值。
en: Correct APN/PDP type and restart the service. Redial, CFUN and hardware reset cannot repair invalid configuration values.

zh: RK3506J SIM 未就绪
en: RK3506J SIM not ready

zh: 【源码直证】CPIN 明确报告非 READY 状态或需要处理的 SIM 锁；初始化 transient 查询不作为永久故障证据。
en: [Source-code evidence] CPIN explicitly reports a non-READY state or SIM lock. Transient initialization queries are not permanent-fault evidence.

zh: 检查卡槽、卡接触和 PIN 锁；保留 CPIN 原始应答，确认不是 AT 通道超时。
en: Check the slot, contacts and PIN lock. Retain raw CPIN responses and distinguish AT timeout.

zh: RK3506J LTE/EPS 未注册
en: RK3506J LTE/EPS unregistered

zh: 【源码直证】注册等待耗尽后明确记录 LTE/EPS is not registered，当前尚不能建立数据连接。
en: [Source-code evidence] LTE/EPS is not registered is explicit after registration wait exhausts; data connectivity cannot yet be established.

zh: 核对 CEREG、运营商选择、覆盖和 SIM 数据权限；不要仅凭一次 CSQ 数值归因。
en: Review CEREG, operator selection, coverage and SIM data permissions. A single CSQ value cannot establish the cause.

zh: RK3506J PDP/ECM 数据激活失败
en: RK3506J PDP/ECM activation failed

zh: 【源码直证】PDP profile、CGACT 或 QNETDEVCTL 的固定 bringup 失败文案表明模组侧数据面未就绪。
en: [Source-code evidence] Fixed PDP profile/CGACT/QNETDEVCTL bringup failure messages indicate the module data plane is not ready.

zh: 核对 APN、PDP 类型、CGACT 与 QNETDEVCTL 原始响应，再检查模组 profile。
en: Check APN, PDP type, raw CGACT/QNETDEVCTL responses and module profile.

zh: RK3506J DHCP/IPv4 配置失败
en: RK3506J DHCP/IPv4 configuration failed

zh: 【源码直证】主机接口缺失、IP/路由不完整，或 DHCP/CGCONTRDP 明确失败；成功静态 IP 与开始回退不作为最终失败。
en: [Source-code evidence] The interface is missing, IP/routes incomplete, or DHCP/CGCONTRDP explicitly failed. Successful static IP or the start of fallback is not final-failure evidence.

zh: 检查接口存在性、udhcpc、IP/网关/默认路由和 CGCONTRDP 响应。
en: Check interface existence, udhcpc, IP/gateway/default route and CGCONTRDP responses.

zh: RK3506J 模组拓扑或 AT 通道不可用
en: RK3506J module topology or AT channel unavailable

zh: 【源码直证】设备发现/AT 端口报告不可用，或基本 AT/CFUN 就绪窗口耗尽、状态机报告传输失败。
en: [Source-code evidence] Discovery/AT reports unavailable, basic AT/CFUN readiness windows exhausted, or the state machine reports transport failure.

zh: 检查 USB 枚举、option 驱动绑定、AT 端口节点及供电，并确认 AT 口和网卡属于同一模组。
en: Check USB enumeration, option binding, AT nodes and power. Confirm AT and network interface belong to the same module.

zh: RK3506J 连通性探测失败
en: RK3506J connectivity probe failed

zh: 【日志直证】状态机记录公网 PING 失败，或保留网络接管后 IP/路由完整但 internet=0；单次失败不等同于已完成重拨。
en: [Log evidence] Public PING failed, or retained-network adoption had complete IP/routes but internet=0. One failure does not establish completed redial.

zh: 结合随后 HB30 的 online、fail_streak/retry 和 FAILURE_RETRY 状态判断是否升级恢复。
en: Use subsequent HB30 online, fail_streak/retry and FAILURE_RETRY to assess recovery escalation.

zh: RK3506J 已进入失败重试状态
en: RK3506J entered failure retry

zh: 【源码直证】FULL-DIAL/EC200A/EG912 状态机明确进入或转移到 FAILURE_RETRY；普通 REDIAL_AT 不等同该状态。
en: [Source-code evidence] FULL-DIAL/EC200A/EG912 explicitly entered FAILURE_RETRY. Ordinary REDIAL_AT is not this state.

zh: 从同一轮前序 bringup、注册、PDP、DHCP 和 AT 证据定位失败层级，保留恢复完成前的完整日志。
en: Locate the failed layer using the same cycle's bringup, registration, PDP, DHCP and AT evidence. Retain logs through recovery completion.

zh: RK3506J SIM 就绪等待耗尽
en: RK3506J SIM readiness wait exhausted

zh: 【日志直证】CPIN 的限时就绪窗口结束仍未获得可接受的 READY；单凭该总结不能确认缺卡或 PIN 锁。
en: [Log evidence] CPIN's bounded readiness window ended without acceptable READY. This summary alone cannot distinguish absent SIM from PIN lock.

zh: 检查前序 CPIN class/state、CME 原码和 AT 传输状态，区分 SIM 初始化、SIM 锁与 AT 不响应。
en: Review preceding CPIN class/state, raw CME codes and AT transport. Distinguish initialization, SIM lock and unresponsive AT.

zh: RK3506J 已进入启动软恢复
en: RK3506J entered startup soft recovery

zh: 【源码直证】保留网络接管失败后进入 SOFT_RECOVERY，先尝试 AT/ECM 恢复。
en: [Source-code evidence] Retained-network adoption failed and entered SOFT_RECOVERY, first trying AT/ECM recovery.

zh: 结合前序 retained、CID、ECM、接口和公网结果定位接管失败层级；后续 PING 成功才证明公网恢复。
en: Review retained, CID, ECM, interface and public probe results to locate the adoption failure. Only subsequent PING success establishes public connectivity recovery.

zh: RK3506J 已进入硬恢复阶段
en: RK3506J entered hard recovery

zh: 【日志直证】启动软恢复或运行期恢复耗尽，明确进入 HARD_RECOVERY；许可 allowed 本身不算执行动作。
en: [Log evidence] Startup soft recovery/runtime recovery exhausted and explicitly entered HARD_RECOVERY. allowed permission alone is not an executed action.

zh: 继续检查 CFUN、POWER/PWRKEY 和冷却日志，确认软关机或物理关机是否成功；不要仅凭阶段名认定已断电复位。
en: Review CFUN, POWER/PWRKEY and cooldown to confirm shutdown. The stage name alone does not establish a physical power cycle.

zh: RK3506J 启动保留网络保护
en: RK3506J startup retained-network protection

zh: 【日志直证】启动期限制破坏性或硬件恢复以保护已有会话；缺少唤醒事件不证明冷启动。
en: [Log evidence] Startup limits destructive/hardware recovery to protect an existing session. No wake event does not establish cold boot.

zh: 结合 MQTT/PDP 保留状态和接管结果判断路径；关注 SOFT_RECOVERY/HARD_RECOVERY 的实际后续动作。
en: Review retained MQTT/PDP state and adoption results. Track actual subsequent SOFT_RECOVERY/HARD_RECOVERY actions.

zh: RK3506J AT 端口缓存未采用
en: RK3506J AT-port cache rejected

zh: 【日志直证】缓存身份、端口或 ATI 校验不满足要求，转入探测；缓存拒绝不等同拨号失败。
en: [Log evidence] Cache identity, port or ATI verification failed and discovery resumed. Cache rejection is not dial failure.

zh: 查看拒绝原因及后续 family/AT ports；只有端口探测或拨号明确失败时再判定通道故障。
en: Review rejection reason and subsequent family/AT ports. Diagnose channel failure only with explicit discovery/dial failure.

zh: RK3506J AT 端口缓存写入失败
en: RK3506J AT-port cache write failed

zh: 【日志直证】缓存无法持久化，源码明确说明 dialing remains active。
en: [Log evidence] Cache persistence failed; source explicitly states dialing remains active.

zh: 检查缓存路径和文件系统权限；依据公网 PING/HB30 判断当前联网，不把缓存写入失败当断网。
en: Check cache path and filesystem permissions. Use public PING/HB30 for connectivity; cache write failure is not an outage.

zh: RK3506J 本地 IPC 等待就绪，拨号继续
en: RK3506J local IPC pending; dialing continues

zh: 【源码直证】NANOMSG 的 PUB/REQ-REP 后台重试；本地 IPC 尚不可用不阻塞拨号。
en: [Source-code evidence] NANOMSG PUB/REQ-REP retries in the background; unavailable local IPC does not block dialing.

zh: 检查 loopback 与本地端点；用公网成功、接管 internet 和心跳判断外网状态。
en: Check loopback/local endpoints. Use public success, adopted internet state and heartbeats for external connectivity.

zh: RK3506J AT 状态查询进入回退验证
en: RK3506J AT-state query entered fallback verification

zh: 【日志直证】CGACT 查询不可用或 QNETDEVCTL 启动未确认，转入幂等激活/只读验证；此时尚不能断言最终数据激活失败。
en: [Log evidence] CGACT query unavailable or QNETDEVCTL start unconfirmed; idempotent activation/read-only verification follows. Final activation failure is not yet established.

zh: 查看随后 CGACT/QNETDEVCTL 状态和公网 PING；只读完整状态行可能在末尾 OK 超时时仍被接受。
en: Review subsequent CGACT/QNETDEVCTL and public PING. A complete read-only state line can be accepted despite a timeout waiting for final OK.

zh: RK3506J DHCP 尝试失败或进入静态 IP 回退
en: RK3506J DHCP attempt failed or static-IP fallback began

zh: 【日志直证】单次 DHCP 尝试失败或开始 CGCONTRDP 回退；静态 IP 成功及公网可达可以完成恢复。
en: [Log evidence] A DHCP attempt failed or CGCONTRDP fallback began. Successful static IP and public reachability can complete recovery.

zh: 检查后续静态地址、网关、路由和 PING；仅在明确最终失败时判断主机网络配置故障。
en: Review subsequent static address, gateway, routes and PING. Diagnose host configuration failure only after explicit final failure.

zh: RK3506J 首次公网 PING 成功
en: RK3506J first public PING success

zh: 【源码直证】每进程首次 PUBLIC PING OK 公告确认接口绑定的 223.5.5.5 可达，作为首次联网边沿。
en: [Source-code evidence] The first PUBLIC PING OK announcement per process confirms interface-bound reachability of 223.5.5.5 and establishes the initial connection edge.

zh: 查看证据中的 path/retained、probe_ms、process_elapsed_ms 和 boot_ms；开机时长与墙钟时间分别解释。
en: Review path/retained, probe_ms, process_elapsed_ms and boot_ms. Interpret boot duration separately from wall-clock time.

zh: RK3506J 模组关机/上电未确认
en: RK3506J module shutdown/power-on unconfirmed

zh: 【日志直证】CFUN 软关机未确认、PWRKEY 脉冲操作失败或关机结果不明；源码可能跳过300秒上电冷却。
en: [Log evidence] CFUN shutdown unconfirmed, PWRKEY pulse failed or shutdown outcome unknown. Source may skip the 300-second power-on cooldown.

zh: 核对具体失败步骤与后续 USB/AT 枚举；不能将未确认关机或允许硬恢复当作已完成物理断电。
en: Review the exact failed step and subsequent USB/AT enumeration. Unconfirmed shutdown or allowed hard recovery is not completed physical power-off.

zh: RK3506J 选网事务失败或结果未验证
en: RK3506J operator-selection transaction failed or unverified

zh: 【日志直证】CFUN/手动选网/查询事务未完成，或历史/候选 PLMN 未通过验证；历史失败转入扫描，候选失败尝试下一项。
en: [Log evidence] CFUN/manual selection/query did not complete, or historical/candidate PLMN was unverified. History failure starts scanning; candidate failure tries the next candidate.

zh: 检查对应 COPS command/status/ok 与后续候选结果；ECM 停止被拒绝不单独算选网失败，选网失败也不证明公网已掉线。
en: Review COPS command/status/ok and later candidates. ECM-stop rejection alone is not selection failure; selection failure does not establish a public outage.

zh: RK3506J 历史 PLMN 选网验证成功
en: RK3506J historical PLMN selection verified

zh: 【源码直证】history PLMN verified 确认指定数字 PLMN 的手动 LTE 查询结果通过严格验证，随后进入 WRITE_TO_MODEM；它不代表已注册或公网已通。
en: [Source-code evidence] history PLMN verified confirms strict verification of the specified numeric PLMN's manual LTE query, followed by WRITE_TO_MODEM. It does not establish registration or public connectivity.

zh: 结合后续 CEREG、PDP/ECM 和公网 PING；旧版 set operator OK 与单独 AT 命令不能提升为这条验证结论。
en: Review later CEREG, PDP/ECM and public PING. Legacy set operator OK or a standalone AT command does not meet this verification standard.

zh: RK3506J EG912 恢复循环重新开始
en: RK3506J EG912 recovery loop restarted

zh: 【源码直证】EG912 第四级恢复重新进入 FAILURE_RETRY 恢复循环；此事件不是恢复完成。
en: [Source-code evidence] EG912 level-four recovery re-enters the FAILURE_RETRY loop. This is not recovery completion.

zh: 检查随后 FAILURE_RETRY/POWER 日志及公网恢复结果；不要把循环重启当作已经切换运营商或已完成物理复位。
en: Review subsequent FAILURE_RETRY/POWER and public recovery. Loop restart does not establish an operator switch or completed physical reset.

en: [Source-code evidence] Shared traffic monitoring skipped sampling/database persistence due to interface counters, database, record saving, clock or thread errors. count is cumulative monitoring failures; logging occurs first and every tenth failure. It is not lost packets or consecutive outages.

en: Investigate interface/storage/time by reason. Persistence failure may retain in-memory totals; interface read failure means missing samples. Neither alone establishes a public outage or zero total traffic.

en: Retain SIM/APN/operator PDP evidence to investigate the initial failure.

en: not earlier device connectivity. A process with no successful ping remains at L0.

en: to the operator, SIM, APN or module.

en: Samples with TX but prolonged RX idle were also recorded, indicating a data-plane anomaly at the fault start.

zh: 结合 PDP 激活结果、CEER、CGACT/CGATT、实际 APN 和运营商 PDP/ESM 原因码定责；
en: Use PDP activation, CEER, CGACT/CGATT, actual APN and operator PDP/ESM reason codes to investigate.

zh: 不要仅以 REG=1 判断设备在线。
en: REG=1 alone does not establish device connectivity.

en: Registration recovered after manual-selection release (strong association)

en: for this unregistered episode, but simultaneous network recovery remains possible; it is not a proven sole cause.

en: No preceding application selection command was observed; the lock's origin is unknown (possibly an earlier session or external AT client).

en: [Source-code evidence] NETWORK REJECTED/Registration Denied is explicit rejection evidence. Raw AT responses are still needed for the specific cause.

en: Review SIM/operator subscription, roaming permissions and raw COPS. Explicit rejection alone does not establish unpaid fees.

en: [Log evidence] SRV!=2(FULL) with DENY>0 indicates a registration/service anomaly; it is not universally equivalent to REG=3 rejection or unpaid fees. Nonzero reason codes under FULL may be residual.

en: Retain raw SRV/RAT/DENY and verify with CEREG/COPS/CEER and SDK version. EG25 DENY=9 means no suitable cells, 10 network failure, 21 nonexistent/unimplemented message type. Do not apply EC200A's encoding.
